rate_limits.correction: Anonymous SODA 2.x requests share an IP-based pool and may be throttled. App-token requests are currently not throttled unless considered abusive or malicious; there is no higher numerical published quota.

cors.correction: supported for read-only access to public datasets

description.correction: The legacy SODA 2.1 endpoint remains supported and permits anonymous public reads with an optional app token. The default SODA 3 query API generally requires identification through an app token or user authentication.

notes: The entry mixes fully supported legacy SODA 2.1 behavior with the current SODA 3 default. Its curl also uses double quotes around $limit, causing ordinary shells to expand the parameter name. Dataset 2nrs-mtv8 remains available but is now historical and no longer updated.
